description: This file defines the 'TaskSchedulerLog' entity class for Doctrine ORM, representing a log of scheduled tasks in the OrangeHRM system, including properties like id, start and finish times, command, input, and status.

classes.name: TaskSchedulerLog
classes.description: Entity class representing a log of scheduled tasks with properties for ID, start/end times, command, input, and status.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the TaskSchedulerLog.

methods.name: setStartedAt
methods.description: Sets the start time of the task log.

methods.name: setFinishedAt
methods.description: Sets the finish time of the task log.

methods.name: setCommand
methods.description: Sets the command associated with the log.

methods.name: setInput
methods.description: Sets the input data for the task log.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status code of the task log.
